about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport P530 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport P530 is the flagship petrol V8 model in the current L461 generation, introduced in 2022. Under the bonnet, it uses the BMW N63 twin-turbo V8, a 4.4-litre unit that represents a significant departure from the previous supercharged AJ-V8 engines used in older models. This engine is shared with the larger L460 Range Rover, reflecting the deep platform sharing between the two models. The P530's V8 offers a blend of performance and refinement that is central to the Range Rover Sport's character, and our rebuild service is designed to restore this engine to its full potential. Range Rover Sport P530 Engine Compatibility The P530 uses a specific BMW-sourced engine code (N63) that is distinct from the other engines in the L461 lineup (the Ingenium 6-cylinder units) and entirely different from the AJ-V8 family used in the previous L494 generation. Fitting the wrong replacement or assuming a part from a different engine will work can lead to expensive compatibility issues. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code via registration or VIN - Your generation (L461) - Drivetrain and ancillary specification - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic P530 quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car. Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Range Rover Sport P530 owners, yes. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Range Rover Sport P530 from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
